name: Klein Gender Slider
description: This LoRA slider was trained on the concept of "male" and "female" related to a person and influes on the physical appearance. The sample weights range from -8 (more feminine) to 6 (more masculine). On T2I, simply don't prompt the person's gender and let the slider weight influe the result. When used on I2I, you need to specify what you want. For example, if you mant to make a male version of a female, specify it in the prompt, then adjust the slider value to increase / decrease masculinity. Hope you like it!
